answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. This holds because each vote is weighted by a track record that only grows through honest participation, turning a Sybil flood into short-lived, low-weight votes.
